verdict.rationale: Undermind's homepage directly claims you can 'get notified whenever relevant papers are published,' and the enterprise page describes 'role-aware alerts' that monitor saved topics and send updates. Both match standing searches that surface new sources. The evidence, however, is marketing-level only. missing for 10: detailed docs on how alerts are set up and configured (frequency, delivery channel, query scope), clarity on whether alerts exist outside the enterprise tier, independent or hands-on corroboration that alerts work.
